CRM Automation Runbook

Build verification after receiving a new CRM SDK path — includes latest comparison & report features

Self-contained — open from any folder

Screenshots are embedded in this file. Copy or email this HTML alone — images still display.

Release context (example)

Old build (_67)\\dvciisilon02\cm_share2\v10.24.1\v10.24.1_67\SDK\Output\SDK_CRM_10.24.1.0_linux64_20260508_1421.jar
New build (_68)\\dvciisilon02\cm_share2\v10.24.1\v10.24.1_68\SDK\Output\SDK_CRM_10.24.1.0_linux64_20260608_0939.jar
CRM version10.24.1
Bundle IDsv10.24.1_67 (baseline) → v10.24.1_68 (new)
Tool URLhttp://localhost:5000/crm (localhost only)
Start toollaunch_comparison_tool.bat or start_server.bat
Reports folder\\<your-pc>\c$\crm_compare_reports

Step 1

Open the received new CRM build UNC path in Windows Explorer and confirm you have read access.

New build folder example: \\dvciisilon02\cm_share2\v10.24.1\v10.24.1_68\SDK\Output\

Step 2

Note the previous bundle CRM build UNC path to use as the Old build baseline for comparison.

Old: v10.24.1_67 SDK JAR · New: v10.24.1_68 SDK JAR

Step 3

Double-click launch_comparison_tool.bat in the Comparison Tool install folder (or start_server.bat) to start the tool on localhost.

One-time install: run INSTALL.cmd after extracting Comparison Tool.zip.

Step 4

Open http://localhost:5000/crm in Chrome or Edge when the browser does not open automatically.

Dismiss the “Before you compare” dialog if shown. Use localhost only — no network URL.

Step 5

Check the Build Comparison checkbox on the home page.

Step 6

Check the CRM/AMSS application checkbox only (do not select ASCF, UXF/OMNI, or DEX).

Step 7

Paste the previous bundle SDK JAR path into the Old build field.

Old build: \\dvciisilon02\cm_share2\v10.24.1\v10.24.1_67\SDK\Output\SDK_CRM_10.24.1.0_linux64_20260508_1421.jar

Step 8

Paste the received new CRM SDK JAR path into the New build field.

New build: \\dvciisilon02\cm_share2\v10.24.1\v10.24.1_68\SDK\Output\SDK_CRM_10.24.1.0_linux64_20260608_0939.jar

Step 9

Optionally click Load CRM base paths and use Use as Old / Use as New to pick paths from the version table.

For a point release you can paste the full SDK JAR paths directly (Steps 7–8).

Step 10

Configure CRM comparison mode and optional reports: Fast CRM/AMSS full compare (recommended, on by default), optional Compare ClfyAgent for nested SDK archives, and optional JAR manifest diff / class diff / crm-playbooks Nexus fields in the CRM/AMSS optional panel.

ClfyAgent only: enable Compare ClfyAgent and disable Fast CRM. Both enabled: fast tree compare plus ClfyAgent size-only nested JAR/WAR/EAR.

Step 11

Click Run comparison and allow the progress tab to open (enable pop-ups if the browser blocks it).

For crm-playbooks Nexus-only checks: fill previous/latest Nexus versions and leave Old/New build empty.

Step 12

Watch Console Output until the comparison finishes and the HTML report opens automatically.

Large SDK JAR comparisons may take 30+ minutes depending on network and disk speed.

Step 13

Review the HTML report: At a glance, side-by-side summary, Version-changed JARs (blue Beyond Compare style), Missing JARs (one side only), ClfyAgent nested container table, major size alerts (|change| ≥ 10%), and path/JAR count mismatch details (release-folder aligned).

Paths under CRM_10.24 vs CRM_10.25 are paired automatically — not listed as false orphans.

Step 14

Save or share the HTML report from \\YOUR-PC\c$\crm_compare_reports if sign-off or audit is required.

Step 15

Optionally enable Environment Validation: enter SSH host/user/password and remote CRM deployment path to validate JAR Implementation-Version on the server. Use Find JAR for class (same SSH credentials) to locate which JAR contains a Java class on the deployment host, then Use in class diff to add it to the class-diff list.

Find JAR runs remote grep under the deployment path (e.g. 10.76.48.68).

Step 16

Run STOP_SERVER.bat in the install folder when verification is complete.

Feature reference (no extra screenshots)

CRM/AMSS optional panel (home page)

  • Fast CRM/AMSS full compare — skips deep archive hashing for faster SDK tree scans.
  • Compare ClfyAgent — size-only nested JAR/WAR/EAR/ZIP inside ClfyAgent in the SDK.
  • JAR names for manifest diff — MANIFEST.MF Implementation-Version table in the report.
  • JAR names for class diff — Perforce-style decompiled Java diffs (needs C:\cfr-0.152.jar).
  • Find JAR for class — SSH grep on deployment; shares Environment Validation credentials.
  • crm-playbooks Nexus TAR — compare amdocs-version/*.yaml between two Nexus builds.
  • File patterns for text/config diffs — limit HTML config diff section to named patterns.
  • Explicit file sizes to compare — force size rows for named archives.

HTML report — new sections

  • At a glance — summary bullets for this comparison run.
  • Build comparison summary (Old vs New) — aligned path counts across CRM release folders.
  • Version-changed JARs — one row per logical JAR; blue rows = version suffix mismatch (Beyond Compare style).
  • Missing JARs (one side only) — true orphans after signature pairing; correct CRM_10.25 paths on new build.
  • ClfyAgent bundle — nested container version mismatch & missing table (blue / red / green).
  • Major size diffs — flagged when |% change| ≥ 10%.
  • Inside-JAR differences — members that differ inside archives present on both builds.
